name: How long does basement molding installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement molding installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an average finished basement with a main living area, bedroom, and hallway, professional molding installation generally takes one to three days. The total timeline expands if the scope includes detailed crown molding, chair rails, or custom door casing alongside standard baseboards. Project speed depends on wall straightness, existing drywall condition, and paint prep. Because owner Abraham Becerra manages finish carpentry along with drywall repair and interior painting, any wall corrections or finishing touches happen seamlessly without having to wait on separate drywall or painting subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement molding installation usually takes one to three days, depending on room layout, drywall alignment, and whether painting is included.
